findings.message: filled.def (38861411B) is not larger than routed.def (38861411B) — fill may be missing

the density artefact carries no per-layer metal CMP density (0 layer values examined; window [20.0%, 80.0%] not applied by this gate) — it carries the OpenROAD filler_placement row/core utilization instead. Where the per-layer rule IS judged: the foundry's own KLayout sign-off DRC deck (met_min_ca_density), where the PDK ships one. Where it is NOT: reports/phase3/metal_density.json is the per-layer measurement, and no flow step judges it — metal_layer_density_check is reachable only through signoff_ladder_run, which no flow step invokes, and tapeout_checklist_gen carries the file as an ADVISORY reviewer row naming that gate without running it. This step's PASS therefore does not mean the per-layer window was checked by anything in this flow.
